question.problem: A curve is defined as $y = 2x^2.$ Find the average rate of change of $y$ over the interval $[0,5].$
question.worked_solution:
Let $f(x)=2x^2.$ Applying the formula for the average rate of change, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{Δy}{Δx} & =\frac{f(b)-f(a)}{b-a} \\  & =\frac{f(5)-f(0)}{5-(0)} \\  & =\frac{(2(5)^{2})-(2(0)^{2})}{5} \\  & =\frac{50}{5} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
